protocol.registration_scope: Internal prospective analysis decisions for this raw-score extension; not external preregistration. Identity/source audits and all previous official-Z results were known; new raw-score model outcomes were not used to choose this protocol.

identity.mapping_formula: raw beer_name k -> one-based row k of published S4 -> its beer key -> official chemistry/sensory beer key

input_paths.public_workbook: work/raw_sensory_check/Supplemental Files and Figure source files.xlsx

data_roles.official_Yz: contest standardized sensory target; old performance retains this identity
data_roles.raw_scores: public supplementary repeated ratings, not independent new beer objects or committee-certified replacement labels
data_roles.full_data_reconstruction: descriptive identity/processing audit only; no full-data taster parameters enter predictive fits

target_definition.raw_primary: within each mapped beer and attribute, observed rating records receive equal weight; q[k] is empirical frequency over 0..6, m=sum(k*q[k])
target_definition.raw_sensitivity: within each beer average repeated records for each taster, then average distinct observed tasters equally; keep predictions and hyperparameters unchanged
target_definition.official_primary: the unchanged 50 official standardized target columns
target_definition.aggregation: equal beer weight then equal target weight; never pool all 2197 records as independent units
target_definition.core_targets: first 30 canonical targets (15 Aroma + 15 Flavour) primary; all 50 reported in parallel
target_definition.inputs_at_prediction: chemical fields only; no beer identity, official test labels, taster/date or test raw scores as covariates

outer_design.source: exact beer and fold arrays in frozen outer_predictions.npz, seed20261023; no regeneration if identity differs
outer_design.group: all rating records of a beer remain in the same outer split
outer_design.inner_source: shared input inner_fold vector aligned with original frozen training order when available
outer_design.foldwise_fit: imputation, input scaling/rank transformation, response scale, low-rank representation and all fitted calibrators use current training beer only
outer_design.prediction_cache_use: only genuine stored fold-excluded predictions for those exact beers; no relabelled cache inference on altered chemistry

raw_point_methods.point_bounds: clip continuous raw score predictions to [0,6] before scoring and output

raw_distribution_methods.train_beer_frequency: mean of training beer q, equal beer weight

cdf_ridge.selection: inner projected CDF squared error, core30

cdf_extra_trees.selection: inner projected CDF squared error, core30

raw_distribution_methods.validity: equal-coordinate Euclidean projection onto 0<=F0<=...<=F5<=1, PAVA plus common bounds; p from CDF differences
raw_distribution_methods.decisions: mean from p for squared raw-score loss; lower median for ordinal absolute loss; mode (lower tied grade) only as separately named exact-class decision

calibration_methods.base: fixed_half_y16_native50 = 0.5*(f16+f50), unchanged neural checkpoints and fixed coefficients
calibration_methods.training_inputs: each outer train set uses its own inner_oof.npz raw231_y16_no_residual/raw231_y50_native; no slicing full outer OOF to make calibration training input
calibration_methods.affine_mean: per-attribute affine with nonnegative slope, clip [0,6], fixed method no hyperparameter selection
calibration_methods.isotonic_mean: per-attribute increasing isotonic regression y in [0,6], out-of-bounds clip, fixed method
calibration_methods.isotonic_cdf: per-attribute six decreasing threshold probabilities Pr(R<=h) against scalar predicted Z, then the same CDF projection; fixed method
calibration_methods.no_cross_method_selection: report all specified calibration methods, no choice using outer outcomes

count_weighted_ridge.selection: inner official-Z core30 variance-normalized MSE; training-side variances only
count_weighted_ridge.weight_normalization: divide by mean weight within current training subset; recompute n median and normalization in each inner train and outer final fit

reduced_rank_ridge.selection: inner official-Z core30 variance-normalized MSE, inner train variances
reduced_rank_ridge.implementation_control: at a fixed lambda with no rank constraint, Z block must be invariant to tau

missingness.methods: all direct raw point/CDF methods and official auxiliary contrasts; frozen neural calibration complete-input only unless genuine matching missingness cache is independently recovered
missingness.mask: for each outer test block draw rng.random(Xtest.shape) over all 231 coordinates with seed=20261023+1000*outer_fold+level and set draw<level/100 to NaN; force all five derived coordinates to NaN afterwards, matching original legacy source
missingness.fit: complete outer train fit and original-input inner selection remain fixed; no test-time retuning or masking target values
missingness.audit: save actual masks or exact mask hashes, train/test IDs, and original missingness pattern

metrics.raw_point_primary: core30 RMSE against raw beer means
raw_point_secondary: core30 MAE against raw beer means
core30 macroR2 against raw beer means
metrics.raw_distribution_primary: core30 mean observed-rating RPS, normalized by 6 thresholds; report reducible CDF error and fixed within-panel term separately
metrics.NLL_floor_scope: separate floor-and-renormalize copy only; do not change main projected probabilities or RPS
metrics.official_comparison: core30 and all50 macroR2 on unchanged official Yz; keep separate from raw results
metrics.inference: paired resampling of beer rows preserves all targets and methods together; model fits fixed; intervals do not quantify new training-sample or new-batch uncertainty

statistics: core30/all50 RMSE difference for raw point comparisons
core30/all50 total RPS difference for distribution comparisons
core30/all50 official macroR2 difference for auxiliary contrasts
paired_bootstrap.interpretation: conditional on stored out-of-fold predictions and observed beer-level targets; no model retraining in bootstrap

reporting.all_candidates: retain all scheduled methods, negative increments, and missingness outcomes
reporting.main_text: methods with demonstrable task value and relevant theory; nonadvantageous extensions remain in supporting results
reporting.terminology: no claim of author codebook, own author correspondence, exact mathematical inverse of aggregated Z, independent external validation from the same beer objects, or official competition score threshold
reporting.previous_results: do not relabel old quantile grades as observed raw grades or old Z R2 as raw-score R2

amendments.reason: Clarify training-mean normalization of predetermined count weights so global loss scale does not alter the Ridge penalty, and fix paired bootstrap reproducibility. No new predictive outcomes inspected by protocol reviewer.
